title: Red herrings 11-20
summary: New 11/20 recording with 24 notes from Andrew to the second: 9 right, 7 left and 8 red herrings (random movements). Goal: tell the red herrings apart from the right / left movements. Notes are used only to evaluate, with leave-one-out for every method that learns from them.
result: DTW unusualness, with no red herring examples, caught 8/8 red herrings with 2/16 false alarms (AUC 0.98, 0.97-0.98 in every setting with angles); supervised methods 21/24 (R/L/RH)
method: Same drift removal and event detection as experiments 06-12 (peaks merged only within 6 s). Compared: one rule, logistic regression, DTW template matching, DTW unusualness with no red herring examples, and 11/11 templates transferred
